topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Well, it seems like the house next door isn't as plain as it appears. I stumbled upon Mr. Thompson's profile the other day, and it turns out he’s been flying under the radar for quite some time. Those cars in his garage and the occasional luxury watch flashing in the sunlight now make a lot more sense. I feel a bit off-kilter, like I've stumbled on a secret I wasn't supposed to find. It’s got me thinking about how little we really know about the people we live beside. I guess it’s a good reminder to keep a bit of mystery about myself too.
